Title: The public preview of Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server now supported in new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server is now available in the Australia Southeast, Brazil South, Korea Central, Norway East, South Africa North, Switzerland North, UAE North, and West US regions. With the addition of Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server to these regions, customers can now enjoy a simplified provisioning experience with:  

  • Optimize lower total cost of ownership (TCO) with burstable SKU  

  • Access to the stop/start feature 

  • Better resiliency with zone redundant high availability  

  • More control with scheduled maintenance  

  • Enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption  

  • The openness of the Postgres database community version    

Read the documentation to learn more about Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server and visit the Azure Database for PostgreSQL products available by region page to learn more about regional availability.
